# ECODrIx

> ECODrIx is a unified business infrastructure platform combining CRM, AI automation, WhatsApp Business API, email marketing, B2B lead intelligence, and cloud storage. Founded August 2025 in Tirupati, India by Dhanesh Mekalthuru. Currently in early access beta (August 2026).

ECODrIx replaces 5–10 separate SaaS subscriptions with one platform for Indian SMBs. WhatsApp-first. No per-seat pricing. 180+ API endpoints.

## URLs

- Marketing site: https://ecodrix.com
- Application: https://console.ecodrix.com
- Public API: https://api.ecodrix.com
- Founder portfolio: https://portfolio.ecodrix.com
- Status: https://status.ecodrix.com

## Products

- [ERIX-CRM](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erix-crm): Sales pipeline, AI lead scoring, WhatsApp inbox, project management, invoicing, client portal. API: /v1/api/product/erix/crm
- [ERIX-FLOW](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erix-flow): Visual drag-and-drop automation engine. 20+ triggers, conditional logic, custom-node marketplace, real-time execution logs. API: /v1/api/product/flow
- [ERIX-LAIE](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erix-laie): B2B lead intelligence — discovery, AI enrichment (Claude/Gemini), dossier research, outreach kits. Powered by Relay Fabric distributed workers. API: /v1/api/product/laie

## Infrastructure

- [ERIX-Connect](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erix-connect): Multi-channel messaging gateway — WhatsApp Cloud API, email (AWS SES), Instagram, Telegram, Google Meet, payments. One send endpoint. API: /v1/api/infra/connect
- [ERIX-Storage](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erix-storage): Cloudflare R2 cloud storage with CDN, presigned uploads, AI-generated alt text/tags. API: /v1/api/infra/storage
- [ErixStore](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erix-store): Proprietary in-memory database — queue, cache, pub/sub, distributed locks, rate limiting. Sub-millisecond. SDK: @ecodrix/erix-client

## Use Cases

- [Real Estate](https://ecodrix.com/platform/real-estate): WhatsApp CRM for property agents — portal lead capture, auto-assign, property sharing on WhatsApp.
- [Healthcare](https://ecodrix.com/platform/healthcare): Clinic CRM — patient inquiries, WhatsApp appointment reminders, teleconsult Meet links.
- [Agencies](https://ecodrix.com/platform/agencies): White-label SaaS for agencies — deploy branded CRM per client, recurring revenue.
- [Education](https://ecodrix.com/platform/education): Coaching institutes — admission inquiries, WhatsApp follow-ups, fee collection.
- [D2C E-Commerce](https://ecodrix.com/platform/d2c-ecommerce): WhatsApp order updates, abandoned cart recovery, COD-to-prepaid conversion.
- [Professional Services](https://ecodrix.com/platform/professional-services): CAs/lawyers — client portal, document exchange, deadline reminders, invoicing.
